recipes.editInstruction: Remove the grey armour from his shoulder and make the bright red tunic bigger so it fills the whole bottom of the portrait across both shoulders and the chest. Keep the yellow-olive face with long sideways ears, big eyes and toothy grin, the red bandana, the grey blade, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: portrait-goblin-goblin-b has the right head (yellow-olive, long sideways ears, grin, red bandana) but grey shoulder armour and 15.9% owner area; portrait-goblin-goblin-a (7.0%) wears armour.

recipes.editInstruction: Make the goblin's face yellow-olive green, and make every brown strap and the brown spear shaft charcoal grey. Keep the bright red hood and tunic, the dark grey wolf head with open jaws beside him, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: portrait-goblin-wolf-rider-b has the right composition (goblin in a red hood with the wolf's head at his side) but brown straps (57 brown pixels) and red-brown shading (21 pixels); portrait-goblin-wolf-rider-a drew a brown cat-like face.

recipes.editInstruction: Make the bright red tunic bigger so it fills the whole bottom of the portrait across his shoulders and chest, and paint the face of the round shield bright red. Keep the grey-olive face with tusks, the dark iron pot helmet, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: portrait-goblin-orc-brute-a is the right orc (pot helmet, tusks, round shield) but 12.9% owner area (COVERAGE_LOW) and crimson shading; portrait-goblin-orc-brute-b (8.2%) wears spiked armour.

recipes.editInstruction: Make the bright red cape bigger so it wraps both shoulders and fills the whole bottom of the portrait, make the horns pale cream, and make the brown straps charcoal grey. Keep the grey-olive face with tusks and shouting mouth, the horned iron helmet, the tin megaphone, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: portrait-goblin-orc-warboss-a is the right chief (horned helmet, megaphone, red cape) but 9.8% owner area (COVERAGE_LOW), orange horns and brown straps; portrait-goblin-orc-warboss-b likewise (9.8%) with crimson shading.

recipes.editInstruction: Paint over the grey patches and dark spots on the rocket with the same bright red, so the rocket body is one big plain bright red shape with a darker red shadow. Keep the grey nose cone and fins, the charcoal cart, the tiny goblin, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: portrait-goblin-rocket-cart-a is the right whole rocket cart, but grey patches split the rocket and its shading is crimson (25 pixels); portrait-goblin-rocket-cart-b turned the rocket into a red-brown ball with a face (RED_BROWN_MATERIAL).

recipes.editInstruction: Make his skin stone grey-green with dark olive moss tufts, not tan or pink, and make the bright red smock bigger so it fills the whole bottom of the portrait across his huge shoulders. Keep the big drooping nose, tusks, the stone club on his shoulder, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: portrait-goblin-troll-a has the right bust (huge nose, tusks, stone club, red smock) but a tan-pink head and 13.3% owner area; portrait-goblin-troll-b (4.0%) wears armour.
